fact: The regional project coordination committee of ECOWAS's West Africa Regional Digital Integration Programme (WARDIP), implemented by Guinea among others, held its first meeting in Conakry on 11 November 2025.
title: La CEDEAO réunit le comité régional de coordination du projet WARDIP
publisher: Communauté Economique des Etats de l’Afrique de l’Ouest (CEDEAO)
